title: e-Office
text:
Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (AWKUM) has adopted E-Office, an innovative solution developed by the National Information Technology Board (NITB), to modernize its internal processes and transition toward a fully digital, paperless environment. This initiative aligns with AWKUM’s commitment to efficiency, transparency, and the effective use of technology in administrative governance.

E-Office represents a major step forward in transforming conventional manual workflows into a streamlined digital system. By replacing paper-based file management, it enables departments at AWKUM to electronically create, manage, and share official documents securely and efficiently. The platform supports seamless collaboration among users while maintaining a well-structured and traceable document repository.

Through the implementation of E-Office, AWKUM is enhancing institutional productivity, accelerating decision-making processes, and contributing to the broader goal of digital governance in Pakistan’s higher education sector.
